func founderVNICMatches(vnic core.Vnic, vnicID string, row bootstrap.FounderPeerRow) bool {
	nsgs := slices.Clone(vnic.NsgIds)
	slices.Sort(nsgs)
	return value(vnic.Id) == vnicID && strings.HasPrefix(value(vnic.CompartmentId), "ocid1.compartment.") &&
		value(vnic.AvailabilityDomain) == row.AvailabilityDomain && value(vnic.SubnetId) == row.SubnetOCID &&
		value(vnic.PrivateIp) == row.PrivateIP && vnic.IsPrimary != nil && *vnic.IsPrimary &&
		vnic.LifecycleState == core.VnicLifecycleStateAvailable && slices.Equal(nsgs, row.NetworkSecurityGroupOCIDs) &&
		value(vnic.PublicIp) == ""
}

func founderBootVolumeMatches(volume core.BootVolume, bootID string, row bootstrap.FounderPeerRow) bool {
	return value(volume.Id) == bootID && value(volume.CompartmentId) == row.CompartmentOCID &&
		value(volume.AvailabilityDomain) == row.AvailabilityDomain &&
		value(volume.ImageId) == row.ImageOCID &&
		volume.SizeInGBs != nil && *volume.SizeInGBs == int64(row.BootVolumeGB) &&
		volume.VpusPerGB != nil && *volume.VpusPerGB == 10 &&
		volume.LifecycleState == core.BootVolumeLifecycleStateAvailable
}

vnic.text:
func vnicSubnetMatches(vnic core.Vnic, subnet core.Subnet, instanceID string) bool {
	subnetID := value(vnic.SubnetId)
	region := regionalOCID(instanceID, "instance")
	return region != "" && regionalOCID(value(vnic.Id), "vnic") == region &&
		regionalOCID(subnetID, "subnet") == region &&
		regionalOCID(value(subnet.VcnId), "vcn") == region &&
		value(subnet.Id) == subnetID &&
		strings.HasPrefix(value(subnet.CompartmentId), "ocid1.compartment.") &&
		value(vnic.CompartmentId) == value(subnet.CompartmentId) &&
		subnet.LifecycleState == core.SubnetLifecycleStateAvailable &&
		(subnet.AvailabilityDomain == nil || value(subnet.AvailabilityDomain) == value(vnic.AvailabilityDomain))
}

OCI map objects and fake Compute/network/volume remain unit boundaries. The single real SDK HTTP test uses an unsigned/no-op request signer and httptest; no OCI identity, credentials, production API, IAM or cloud effects qualified.
Local filesystem paths exercise only stated publication, refusal, readback and replay paths. No real process restart, power loss, crash durability, production ownership or service deployment proven.
Assertions in each root are retained as whole exact interior spans, including their branches and conditions; setup assertions are not separate count credit.
Each cited file is pinned as canonical 52eef Git bytes; baseline full test-file pins and exact raw root declarations are retained. All 20 bodies match historical survival hashes.
No ledger, source, repository, runtime, deletion, retirement, qualification or global completion credit. Independent peer review required.
